artifact_role: companion machine-readable preregistration; the active Markdown report remains authoritative for scientific reasoning
owner_hypothesis_class: possible clue only; never proof by numerical resemblance

prior_exposure_disclosure.known_phi_like_null: Priority B already contains 0.6180341947820507 from a deliberately parameterized reciprocal-feedback toy; it is frozen as an anti-numerology negative control, not evidence for golden-ratio physics.

M0_golden_fibonacci: F[n+1]=F[n]+F[n-1] or an equivalent recurrence/eigenvalue mechanism
M1_integer_arithmetic: simple primorial/factorial identities only for genuine integer count observables
M2_riemann_zeta: nontrivial-zero comparison allowed only for a legitimately defined ordered dimensionless spectrum
normalized spectral spacings rather than arbitrary raw-scalar matching
M3_circular_angular: 360-complete-cycle structure only where a real phase/rotation/symmetry observable exists

admissible_lineum_quantities: constants and coefficients genuinely used by the current governing implementation
algorithmic recurrences and operators that affect the current dynamics
grid or symmetry counts only when they have mechanism-level meaning rather than being an arbitrary run configuration
dimensionless ratios between semantically paired quantities
reproducible output ratios retained in the current research evidence
ordered spectra only when the operator and normalization are scientifically defined
excluded_lineum_quantities: test counts used only for coverage
numbers introduced solely to manufacture a requested match
frozen_transform_budget: exact equality or analytically derived identity
integer factorization, gcd/divisor structure, and declared branching products for genuine integer observables
ratio only for semantically paired quantities
first difference or consecutive ratio only for an already ordered sequence
normalized spacing only for an already justified spectrum
forbidden_posthoc_transforms: arbitrary multiplication or division by a free integer
unit changes selected to improve a numerical match
affine rescaling selected after seeing the target
logarithm, exponent, or power selected only because it produces a match
adding a new mathematical family after inspecting Core without a new preregistration checkpoint

screening_rules.approximate_scalar_hit_status: screening clue only, never evidence by itself
screening_rules.output_stability_requirement: for numerically measured ratios, survive at least three already-declared independent resolution/timestep/run conditions where available
screening_rules.structural_candidate_requires: either one exact analytically derived generator-level identity with matching semantics, or at least two independent Lineum manifestations plus rejection of the relevant null

null_controls: calendar/astronomical/angular complete-cycle arithmetic as a historical null for 12/72/360
common highly composite-number convenience as a null for 360
practical metrology and binary subdivision as a historical null for Egyptian dyadic fractions
look-elsewhere effect from testing many constants and transforms
toy-only coincidence that does not recur in current Lineum
multiple_comparison_rule: count every tested admissible quantity-family pair; if a sequence/spectrum supplies enough points for numerical significance, compare against an appropriate shuffled/randomized or matched combinatorial null before promotion
planned_phases: current retained Lineum result audit for robust dimensionless ratios/sequences
mathematical-family comparison under the frozen transform budget
historical-source receipt and null audit for Gospel of Judas and Egyptian fractions
separate preregistered Lineum experiment only if a structural candidate survives

third_party_intake.incorporation: no third-party translation, figure, code, dataset, or protected expression is incorporated
third_party_intake.exact_historical_source_receipts: must be added before decision-relevant historical inference; this preregistration itself makes no new historical-source conclusion

interpretation_boundary.structural_candidate: hypothesis worth a separately preregistered test
interpretation_boundary.no_match: no support in the tested current-Core scope; not a falsification of the historical text

next_action_after_authoritative_markdown: perform the frozen static current-Core audit before any new numerical transform family is introduced
